name: Knot ~Kizuna no Mahou~
source:
Main character became director of "The Study Group on Magic" school club. He needs to figure out why "magic" begins to intervene in this world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]

主人公成为校内"魔法研究会"的部长。他必须查明"魔法"为何开始介入这个世界。
